::: {#exm-hers-diff-means-ci}
#### Confidence interval for the HERS baseline glucose difference

Continuing @exm-hers-ttest,
the 95% interval of @def-ci-diff-means is:

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
(mean(glucose_ht) - mean(glucose_placebo)) +
  c(lower = -1, upper = 1) * qt(0.975, df_welch) * sqrt(v_ht + v_placebo)
```

This interval matches the one `t.test()` reports in @exm-hers-ttest.
It contains 0, consistent with the large p-value there.
:::
